title: Simplify pi-goal to Codex-style completion and continuation

logs.msg: Replaced evidence/checkpoint/evaluation protocol with Codex-style objective-only create_goal, get_goal, and update_goal tools. Removed extension-level hard limits and all goal-owned provider abort calls; stale queued continuations now drain inertly instead of aborting. Added schema v3 and focused lifecycle/replay tests. bun test, tsc, and diff check pass.
